hook: An entire Silk Road city vanished beneath a mountain lake 800 years ago.

sections.voiceover: An entire Silk Road city vanished beneath a mountain lake 800 years ago.
sections.visual_cue: Underwater drone shot descending into dark mountain lake waters revealing ancient stone masonry.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep underwater resonance and low drone.

sections.voiceover: Divers exploring Lake Issyk-Kul in Kyrgyzstan discovered the submerged ruins of Toru-Aygyr. The RGS and the National Academy of Sciences of the Kyrgyz Republic mapped the site. Can you imagine a sunken city covering five square kilometres?
sections.visual_cue: Divers with underwater lights swimming past submerged walls in Lake Issyk-Kul.

sections.voiceover: Yet this network linked China to the Mediterranean starting from the 2nd century BC.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of ancient coin resting on underwater silt.

sections.voiceover: Divers from the RGS mapped the sunken city across five square kilometres of Toru-Aygyr.
sections.visual_cue: Archival expedition footage showing researchers examining artifacts on a boat.
b_roll: RGS expedition boat on Lake Issyk-Kul

sections.voiceover: Five square kilometres of lost history remain submerged in Lake Issyk-Kul.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of the vast expanse of Lake Issyk-Kul surrounded by mountains.
